title: parameters of the user items: a parameter vector passed to the user functions
author: Claude-JG
description: ObjectUserBody (and future user items) has no parameters; they are written into the user functions. For a user beam with different parameters per element, an arbitrary-length parameter vector of doubles (also for bools and indices) passed to the user functions, with a Python mapping between the vector and a dict of interpretable quantities (mass, inertia, COM, ...), which keeps symbolic quantities when recording; zero length is the present behaviour; the mapping possibly part of the item as a Python function used at definition. First evaluate and recommend.
releaseNotes: ObjectUserBody and NodeUser have a parameter vector 'parameters'; their user functions get qRef, q, q_t and the parameters (the outputVariableUserFunction also q_tt, the graphicsDataUserFunction of ObjectUserBody the visualization configuration); exudyn.advancedUtilities.ParameterLayout maps the parameters to named quantities and back, for numpy and symbolic vectors, so that one recorded symbolic user function serves every body of a kind (revision2026c steps RG7.12.1-RG7.12.3)
